description: Find evidence across selected project context documents. Batch independent queries; use passages directly when sufficient. Results merge overlapping text and include source ranges and zero-based queryIndexes into queries. matched reports a hit; truncated means evidence may be omitted, clipped means partial lines, and unavailableResourceIds were not searched. Resolve missing evidence before concluding a fact is absent.

maxCharacters.description: Shared passage character budget across all documents and queries.

queries.description: Independent case-insensitive literal terms matched within a line, not questions or regular expressions.

resourceIds.description: Selected text resource ids from the project context index, in relevance order.

name: websiteKnowledge_search
title: Search project context documents
